ownerDecisionsNeeded.decision: Content projection policy: the Phase 3-4 gates were derived for the 101-target pool, but runtime has 15 recipes (18 with tranche T1)

options.name: AUTHORITY_VERBATIM_CONTENT_TRANCHED
options.summary: Use authority gates/prices unchanged. Ship content tranches in authority sequence order. At guaranteed-minimum ⭐, shipped recipes beyond the tranche (marinara, napoletana, pizza-bianca, genovese, quattro-formaggi) stay reachable only by raising BEST until later tranches land. Needs end-of-content UX

options.name: PROJECTED_GATES
options.summary: Re-derive gates with the same G4_HYBRID_060 formula over the runtime pool (illustration in the Graph JSON). All 15 reachable, but gate values change and must be re-derived every tranche (gates would rise as content lands)

options.name: CONTENT_FIRST
options.summary: Keep EP1/EP4 until content reaches authority sequence 92 (needs 6+ capabilities). Delays the Phase 3-4 loop by many slices

slices.name: Progression rules foundation (headless, unwired)
slices.purpose: Pure functions + authority table import: progressionStars (Σ max(2,BEST)), ingredientLifecycle, purchase-with-grant, refill (R10 at 0.5×), portion→piece conversion, parity/deadlock/economy-simulation tests against the Phase 3-4 JSON
dependencies: none (does not touch gameReducer.ts, lunchRush.ts, orders.ts — no overlap with PR #202)
slices.tests: new focused unit: JSON parity, hybrid ⭐ table, lifecycle truth table, purchase/refill atomicity, projected-pool deadlock check, first-N event parity with the authority simulation
slices.webkit: Classifier-required per #201 (src/**) but expected no-op; not a merge concern
slices.rollback: Revert the PR; nothing imports the new modules

slices.name: Save forward-compat + existing-save transition contract
slices.purpose: Sanitizer preserves unknown (future) ingredient/recipe ids instead of dropping them; codify transition rules (owned kept, EP4 ledger inert, stock kept) as tests before any rule cutover
dependencies: none; must be DEPLOYED before 3-4G ships any new id
slices.tests: persistence unit: unknown-id round-trip, v1/v2 fixtures, rollback simulation (new-build save → old-build load → re-save keeps ids)
slices.rollback: Revert; saves written meanwhile stay loadable (extra ids ignored)

slices.name: Unlock/purchase rule cutover (atomic)
slices.purpose: Wire 3-4A: retire EP1 recipe unlock from availability, retire EP4 recipe-keyed Starter Grant, gates on progression ⭐, authority prices, purchase grants 10 portions, refill R10. Minimal Shop wiring so AVAILABLE_TO_BUY rows are buyable with the existing Shop UI; Pizza Select LOCKED reason no longer uses EP1
slices.tests: reducer/progression/economy/starterStock/pizzaSelect unit; full unit suite (fixture fallout expected, like P3-3)
slices.e2e: Chromium full (both viewports); new e2e: buy egg → Bismarck discoverable
slices.rollback: Revert restores EP1/EP4; purchases made meanwhile stay OWNED (permanent), so no loss

slices.name: Shop progression UX
slices.purpose: LOCKED rows show 'あと⭐N', AVAILABLE_TO_BUY highlight + price, count-only 'new pizzas may be possible' hint (no spoiler), stock portions + refill row, purchase feedback

slices.name: HOME / RESULT / DISCOVERED next-goal guidance
slices.purpose: One 'next goal' line on HOME (priority: discoverable-now count → affordable item → Pitz short → ⭐ short → end-of-content), ⭐ gain + next unlock on RESULT/DISCOVERED, Pizza Select undiscovered copy
slices.tests: pure guidance selector truth table; component tests

slices.name: Lunch Rush stock-aware pool
slices.purpose: Mission pool = discovered ∩ available ∩ in-stock (per the #202 contract, plus X-5 stock); empty → fail closed with a HOME reason
